question: If the HCF and the LCM of two numbers are 7 and 245, respectively, then their product is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **product of two numbers** is always equal to the product of their **HCF** and **LCM**.

Required Product = **HCF × LCM**

⇒ Product = 7 × 245 = 1715

**∴ The correct answer is 1715.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ **HCF** of two numbers = 7

⇒ **LCM** of two numbers = 245

**Formula used:**

⇒ **Number₁ × Number₂ = HCF × LCM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e38c8e480b28f6930615238d06d45ee327b28dd60604b8baa4e0a8e4489954f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Product of two numbers = 7 × 245

⇒ Product = 7 × (200 + 40 + 5)

⇒ Product = 1400 + 280 + 35

⇒ Product = 1715

**∴ The correct answer is 1715.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Property of HCF and LCM

For any two positive integers a and b, the relationship is **HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b**.

HCF as a Factor

The **HCF** of any set of numbers is always a **factor** of their **LCM**.

Co-prime Numbers

For **co-prime** numbers, the HCF is always **1** and the LCM is the **product** of the numbers themselves.</p
